honors.title: 1st Place in General Electric Digital's 2017 CSU Internet-of-Things Hackathon
honors.description:
Leveraged GE Digital's Predix technology to create University Parking Lot Management System using Raspberry Pis, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Micro-service Architecture, and security oriented design to create solve existing problems faced by University and Corporate parking administrators and create viable business model.

This competition Began in April 2017 and run until the competition finale at GE Digital's HQ on Friday July 14th, 2017. The competition was held amongst several California State Universities and each university was allowed one team of up to six students. I was on Cal Poly's team and my functions were primarily searching for business connections, finding stakeholders, and using stakeholder pains and desires to guide product development.
honors.issuer: Issued by General Electric Digital · Jun 2017
